content: ruby/setup-ruby@v1 ruby-version input adds a prebuilt Ruby to PATH (~5s); quoting versions ('3.2') avoids YAML float traps; macOS runner images removed Ruby 3.0 (2025-02-17) and default to 3.3/3.4 on current images, so pinning via setup-ruby is the consistent path. spm-cache gemspec requires >= 3.1.0; action pins '3.2' quoted.
